decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1. Five wider parking bays for people with limited mobility shall be located in the northeastern corner of the site within one month of the date of this permission, and shall thereafter be retained.
Condition : 2 - 2. The gate on the northern boundary of the site shall be kept open and available for use during opening hours of the car park.

Condition : 3 - 3. Prior to first occupation of the car park, a scheme outlining the pricing structure to encourage short term parking shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, and implemented in accordance with the approved plan.
Condition : 4 - 4. The permission hereby granted for a shoppers car park shall be for a limited period of two years, expiring on 13th September 2003
description: CHANGE OF USE TO FORM CAR PARK.
